title: Reference Harness stream normalization probe
question: Can the Reference Harness normalize a fragmented model stream into one deterministic event sequence without depending on hidden model state?
hypothesis: Both repetitions will preserve stream order, mark the final model response, produce the expected answer, and share one normalized Trace fingerprint.
success_criteria: Both repetitions expose the declared final stream frame and completed stop reason.
Both repetitions return the exact expected answer and share one normalized Trace fingerprint.
limitations: The Scripted Model and Reference Harness are deterministic teaching components, not Native vendor evidence.
The probe validates the declared normalization path only; it does not cover malformed or vendor-specific streams.
The experiment does not measure latency, token usage, cost, or model capability.
